type.description: REQUIRED (§4.1). A short, self-explanatory kind — "BigQuery Table", "Playbook", "Metric". NOT centrally registered: an unknown value is legal and consumers must tolerate it

description.description: Recommended. One sentence summarizing the concept

resource.description: Recommended. URI uniquely identifying the underlying asset; absent for abstract concepts

tags.description: Recommended. Short strings for cross-cutting categorization

resource.description: REQUIRED (§5.1). A followable artifact — URL, bundle-relative path, references/ path — or a scope descriptor such as "all queries in BigQuery project X"

id.description: Stable key used as a markdown footnote label to attribute individual claims

author.description: Credibility signal: who or what produced the source

usage_count.description: Credibility signal: how often the resource was exercised over usage_window. Liveness and trend, never a score

last_modified.description: Credibility signal: when the source itself last changed (distinct from generated.at)

usage_window.description: Per-entry override of the sibling-level usage_window

sources.description: Provenance: the materials this concept derives from (§5.1)

usage_window.description: Datetime range framing every usage_count in sources (§5.1)

at.description: When the content last meaningfully changed

generated.description: Trust: how the current content was produced (§5.2)

by.description: Who or what confirmed the content

verified.description: Trust: verification events. A bare mapping MUST be read as a one-element list (§5.2)

status.description: Lifecycle (§5.4). Conventionally draft | stable | deprecated; absent means stable. Left open because §11 makes values beyond those three soft guidance

stale_after.description: Lifecycle (§5.5). An absolute instant: the concept is stale when now >= stale_after

okf-concept-frontmatter.description: OKF v0.2 concept-document frontmatter — permissive by specification (§4.1, §11)
